notes: Legacy ADC (later TE Connectivity/CommScope) 19", 2RU passive video patch bay: two rows of 24 = 48 points (96 physical jacks total: 48 front + 48 rear), all 75Ω coax for analog composite/component or SDI signals. No manufacturer/current CommScope product page could be located (line is discontinued); best available spec source is the specialist patchbay reseller Mr. Patchbay, cross-checked against several other secondary listings (eBay, GRCC Online Store, eRecycler) that consistently describe: 19" 2RU steel chassis, 48-point, SJ2000N-75 front jacks, BNC rear, 75Ω termination, and Normal-through wiring (the trailing "N" in the part number; the same chassis without "N" — "PPI-2224RS" — ships Non-Normal/isolated). This is a fully passive component with no power connector. Ports are summarized as 4 representative 24-jack groups (front row A/B, rear row A/B) rather than 96 near-identical individual entries; each physical jack is a plain bidirectional 75Ω BNC-type coax path with no bandwidth grade published (sources variously cite suitability from analog baseband up through 292M HD-SDI, but no single authoritative bandwidth spec was found, so "grade" was left unset rather than guessed). Front jacks are ADC's proprietary reduced-size "Superjack" (SJ2000N-75), which is physically smaller than a standard BNC and needs matching mini/midsize patch cords — connector id "bnc" was used as the closest match since no dedicated midsize-video-jack id exists in the allowed list.

ports.name: Front Jacks 1-24 (Row A)
ports.note: Represents 24 identical front-panel ADC SJ2000N-75 'Super Video Jacks' — a proprietary reduced-size (RS/midsize) 75Ω coax video jack, not a literal full-size BNC; mapped to the closest listed connector id. Normal-through (the '-75N' suffix) wiring internally bridges each front jack to its corresponding rear BNC jack until a patch cord is inserted.

ports.name: Front Jacks 25-48 (Row B)
ports.note: Represents 24 identical front-panel ADC SJ2000N-75 'Super Video Jacks' (reduced-size midsize jack, closest connector id used); normalled to rear BNC row B.

ports.name: Rear Jacks 1-24 (Row A)
ports.note: Represents 24 identical rear-panel BNC field-wiring connectors (75Ω), permanently normalled to front Row A.

ports.name: Rear Jacks 25-48 (Row B)
ports.note: Represents 24 identical rear-panel BNC field-wiring connectors (75Ω), permanently normalled to front Row B.
